name: SDPR
model_likelihood: Standardized linear trait model; Gaussian summary likelihood with covariance R/N, overlap-adjusted R Hadamard H, or working R/N+aI after deflation correction.
prior: Zero-centered normal variance mixture with Dirichlet-process prior; parameter expansion beta=eta gamma; finite stick-breaking truncation and zero first variance component.
inference_algorithm: Collapsed Gibbs assignment sampling and joint effect updates within approximately independent LD blocks; parallel assignment updates across blocks.
estimand: Posterior-sample averages of effect sizes beta and heritability beta-transpose R beta.
data_input: Marginal GWAS summary statistics; sample sizes; ancestry-matched external reference LD; study overlap if known.
tunable_settings: Mixture truncation M=1000; likelihood inflation aN and deflation factor c; LD block r2 threshold 0.1; MCMC iterations.
